text.tspan: Income inequality: Gini coefficient before and after tax
Inequality is measured in terms of the Gini coefficient of income before taxes on the horizontal axis and after
taxes on the vertical axis. The latest available estimates are shown for each country.
Note: Income has been equivalized. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2034 is shown
